findings.reason: The evidence confirms the maintenance window and alarms, but does not prove causality or that the interruptions were 'expected' rather than a failure.
T1 and ALR-0006 explicitly state the drop in traffic, active users, and availability on the three sites for 4 hours.
T2, T3, and T4 all show the dependency chain S-TUN-xxx -> LNK-TUN-01-C.
T5 and ALM-000140 confirm the alarm time and node; T7 and MW-0002 confirm the maintenance window covered that time.
T5 and the specific alarm references confirm SITE_DOWN alarms on the three sites at 02:38, one minute after the link loss.
T7 and MW-0002 explicitly state the maintenance window times and node.
The evidence shows the upgrade occurred at 03:14 (after start), but does not provide data to prove it 'did not cause' the drop.
